review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native Thai review (preferably a Chiang Mai speaker; the text is spoken-standard Central Thai). Speakers: sam=Sam (man; ผม … ครับ), mali=Mali (woman; ฉัน … ค่ะ / คะ), ball=Ball (boy, ten; ผม … ครับ). For the reviewer - a phone call on a Sunday afternoon (the plan said Saturday; Mali works on Saturday in th-a1-1-14); กำลัง + verb and verb + อยู่ for "is doing"; "นี่แซมครับ" as the way to say who is calling; "เดี๋ยวครับ" (just a moment); คุณมะลิ is how Ball addresses Mali (check: อา would be the real kin term).
